features: POCKET-SIZE RETRO CAMERA WITH 1.47 INCH SCREEN — Designed for daily carry, travel pouches, bags, and gift sets. The compact body and flip screen make it easy to preview clips, check framing, and capture quick everyday moments.

PHOTO + VIDEO MODES FOR CASUAL SHOOTING — Supports photo output settings from 1M to 48M and video options in 1080P or 720P AVI format, giving you a simple all-in-one mini camera for snapshots and short clips.
USB-C RECHARGEABLE FOR EASY EVERYDAY USE — Recharge through a USB-C power setup for convenient charging and file transfer. Built for quick grab-and-go use without a bulky camera bag.
MICROSD READY WITH EXPANDABLE STORAGE — Supports microSD/TF cards up to 128GB, so you can save photos and videos in one ultra-compact camera. Great for travel days, parties, and creative daily carry.
GIFT-READY MINI CAMERA SET — Package includes the camera, manual, gift box, lobster clasp, and lanyard for a portable, easy-to-carry setup that works well as a birthday, holiday, or novelty gift.
description: Bring a retro camera look to your everyday moments with this mini flip screen digital camera. Designed for casual use, travel days, parties, gifts, and daily carry, it combines a compact pocket-size body with easy photo and video functions in a fun, portable format. The 1.47 inch screen helps with quick preview and framing, while USB-C charging keeps daily use simple. With support for microSD/TF expansion up to 128GB, this small camera is made for capturing spontaneous memories without the bulk of a traditional camera. Important note: A microSD/TF card is required for photo and video capture. If you are not bundling a card, state “memory card not included” clearly in the description and image set.
